title: Jets release kicker Younghoe Koo; sign Jason Sanders

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets release kicker Younghoe Koo; sign Jason Sanders
sources.description: The Jets are releasing veteran kicker Younghoe Koo just days after he was signed. Another kicker, Jason Sanders, is being signed to take his roster spot. The Jets signed Koo less than a week ago so it is a bit of a surprise to see him gone so quickly. Koo reportedly struggled at OTAs. Perhaps […]
